answer.rationale: Rollback is prohibited by compliance, so memory_b1 is inapplicable. Write-path latency at settlement peak suggests resource contention on the primary; memory_b5 shows routing report reads to replicas recovered write latency same-day, and it is reversible with no risk to customer writes. Memory_b3 supports capacity-based relief for peak surges, but mid-peak provisioning is slower and riskier than shifting read load; I verify b3 and b5 to confirm read/write contention was the actual mechanism before committing. If verification shows b5's case was read-driven contention and current metrics show heavy dashboard/report load on the primary, route_read_replicas is the lowest-risk intervention that preserves writes; otherwise add_capacity is the fallback next window.
